title: Ore Sniffer In Hand
description: Now I don't plan on going through each and ev'ry tool there is, cause there's a lotta them. However, I feel it's worth talking about the [Prospector Hammer](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/prospector_hammer.png:124:62) cause of its unique ability. When right clicking the side of a block, the prospector hammer will tell you if there are any ores in that direction. It's got a detection width of 3 blocks, the block you click and one on each side of it, and a range of 16 blocks ahead of you.
